name: Legacy Pyodide Code - _input Is Not Defined
description: Tests migration of Pyodide-era code (_input, _now, dot access) to native Python on n8n 2.x
query:
I copied this Python Code node from an older n8n template and on n8n 2.x it fails with "name '_input' is not defined":

```python
all_items = _input.all()
total = sum(item.json.amount for item in all_items)
return [{"json": {"total": total, "generated_at": str(_now)}}]
```

How do I fix it?
expected_behavior: Explain n8n 2.x runs native Python; the Pyodide helpers (_input, _json, _node, _now, _jmespath) no longer exist
Replace _input.all() with _items (Run Once for All Items mode)
Replace dot access item.json.amount with item["json"].get("amount", 0)
Explain _now is unavailable and there is no datetime import by default; pass a timestamp in via an expression ({{ $now.toISO() }}) or use JavaScript
